ApprovalDecision.description: The decision or lifecycle transition of an approval.
ApprovalDecision.title: ApprovalDecision

ApprovalEvent.description: A human-in-the-loop approval-workflow event: a request for approval and its lifecycle transitions (approved/rejected/escalated/expired).

actor.description: The acting principal that caused the event (e.g. "agent://flywheel", "user:ada@acme.com", "system"). Required on every event.

approval_id.description: Id of the approval request this event pertains to.

config_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the fully-resolved, canonicalized configuration tree, frozen at process start and stamped on every event (SPEC §4).

decision.description: The approval decision or lifecycle transition this event records.

event_id.description: Platform-canonical unique id for this event instance.

event_type.description: Canonical event-type discriminator (e.g. "audit", "correction_signal", "approval", "cost", "shape_violation"). Set by the emitting factory.

kpi_tag.description: Optional KPI tag associating this event with a tracked KPI (C8, KPI-first). Denormalized onto the outbox row for the reporting path.

provenance.description: Where the event and the state it describes came from — a small string map (source, pipeline, commit, …). Required; may be empty.

sla_deadline.description: Optional SLA deadline by which the approval must be resolved.

subject_ref.description: Reference (id/URN) to the action or artifact awaiting approval.

tier.description: Approval tier (0–3): the sensitivity/authority level required, 0 being the lowest. Mirrors ne-contracts ApprovalTier.

trace_id.description: Optional OTel/trace correlation id linking this event to a span in the observability backend.

ApprovalEvent.title: ApprovalEvent

actor.description: The acting principal that caused the event (e.g. "agent://flywheel", "user:ada@acme.com", "system"). Required on every event.

config_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the fully-resolved, canonicalized configuration tree, frozen at process start and stamped on every event (SPEC §4).

detail.description: Optional free-text detail about the action or its outcome.

event_id.description: Platform-canonical unique id for this event instance.

event_type.description: Canonical event-type discriminator (e.g. "audit", "correction_signal", "approval", "cost", "shape_violation"). Set by the emitting factory.

kpi_tag.description: Optional KPI tag associating this event with a tracked KPI (C8, KPI-first). Denormalized onto the outbox row for the reporting path.

outcome.description: Whether the action succeeded, was denied, or errored.

provenance.description: Where the event and the state it describes came from — a small string map (source, pipeline, commit, …). Required; may be empty.

resource.description: The resource the action was taken on (e.g. a URN or path).

trace_id.description: Optional OTel/trace correlation id linking this event to a span in the observability backend.

CorrectionSignal.description: A correction/feedback signal on a system output — the raw material of the improvement flywheel (thumbs, edits, wrong-source flags, re-queries).

actor.description: The acting principal that caused the event (e.g. "agent://flywheel", "user:ada@acme.com", "system"). Required on every event.

comment.description: Optional free-text comment accompanying the correction.

config_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the fully-resolved, canonicalized configuration tree, frozen at process start and stamped on every event (SPEC §4).

event_id.description: Platform-canonical unique id for this event instance.

signal_kind.description: The kind of correction signal observed.

subject_ref.description: Reference (id/URN) to the subject the signal is about — the answer, citation, retrieval, or approval the correction targets.

trace_id.description: Optional OTel/trace correlation id linking this event to a span in the observability backend.

value.description: Optional numeric magnitude for the signal (e.g. an edit distance or a score); interpretation depends on signal_kind.

CostEvent.description: A cost/usage accounting event for a model invocation — tokens, dollars, and the lane (frontier API vs private vLLM) the spend occurred on.

actor.description: The acting principal that caused the event (e.g. "agent://flywheel", "user:ada@acme.com", "system"). Required on every event.

config_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the fully-resolved, canonicalized configuration tree, frozen at process start and stamped on every event (SPEC §4).

cost_usd.description: Cost of the invocation in US dollars.

event_id.description: Platform-canonical unique id for this event instance.

event_type.description: Canonical event-type discriminator (e.g. "audit", "correction_signal", "approval", "cost", "shape_violation"). Set by the emitting factory.

kpi_tag.description: Optional KPI tag associating this event with a tracked KPI (C8, KPI-first). Denormalized onto the outbox row for the reporting path.

lane.description: The serving lane the invocation used. Conventionally "frontier-api" or "private-vllm"; kept as a free string so new lanes need no schema bump.

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock latency of the invocation in whole milliseconds — one monotonic delta from call start to termination, rounded to the nearest integer (B12). OMITTED (None) when not measured: absent means unknown, never zero.

model.description: The model identifier the cost is attributed to.

provenance.description: Where the event and the state it describes came from — a small string map (source, pipeline, commit, …). Required; may be empty.

task.description: Optional task/route label the invocation served.

trace_id.description: Optional OTel/trace correlation id linking this event to a span in the observability backend.

ttft_ms.description: Time to first token in whole milliseconds — streaming invocations only: the monotonic delta from call start to the first chunk received (B12). OMITTED (None) for non-streaming invocations and for a stream that terminated before any chunk arrived.

PlatformEvent.description: Abstract base for every platform event. Carries the fields SPEC §4 mandates on EVERY event: identity, type, the process-start config_hash, the acting principal, provenance, and the occurrence timestamp, plus an optional KPI tag and trace correlation id. Concrete events (AuditEvent, CorrectionSignal, ApprovalEvent, CostEvent, ShapeViolation) extend it.

ProvenanceEntry.description: A single provenance key/value pair. Provenance on an event is a small map (e.g. "source", "pipeline", "commit") recording where the event and the state it describes came from; it is modelled as an inlined collection of these entries so it renders as a plain string map on the generated model.

key.description: Provenance key (unique within one event's provenance map).
